title: Activating History Generation

children:
You will determine if the system will generate history records for most 
 warehouse operations. Each operation is associated with a particular history 
 type. The system activates most types of history record generation by 
 default.
The following history types are tracked in SCALE:

Transaction History: Any 
 time inventory is impacted by either system or user activity, The system 
 writes a transaction record identifying what happened. Examples of transaction 
 types are shipment allocation and short pick adjustment.

Process History: Any time 
 the system either makes a decision or performs a transaction without user 
 assistance, the it writes a process record identifying what happened. 
 Examples of processes are carrier assignment and shipment processing.

Quality History: Any time 
 an employee provides a reason code to explain a discrepancy during processing, 
 the system writes a quality record identifying what happened. Examples 
 of quality history are selecting the wrong item.

Receipt Quality 
 History: Any time that an employee checks in a license plate on a new 
 receipt, closes a receipt, or reopens a closed receipt, the system writes 
 a quality record. Examples of receipt quality history are items not received 
 and missed expected receipt date.

(the fields that display will depend 
 on which history window is accessed)

Use the Create 
 History? Field to identify whether or not you want the system to 
 generate history for this operation:

To generate history for this 
 operation, choose Yes. Note that you will need to perform a    reset in order for the system to 
 start recording this type of history.

To not generate 
 history for this operation, choose 
 No. Note that you will need to perform a    reset in order for the system to stop recording this type of history.

For transaction 
 history, you will need to also determine if this type of history 
 will be included in inventory transaction interface uploads.

For quality history, you will need to choose a process and/or 
 disposition code that is associated with this type of history.

Press OK. 
 The system will save your changes.
